name: vscode-agent-status
displayName: Agent Status for Codex & Claude Code
description: Shows Codex and Claude Code task status and marks notifications read when you return to VS Code.

commands.title: Agent Status: Mark Selected Task Read
Agent Status: Clear Read Completed Tasks

agentStatus.stateDirectory.description: Directory containing task state JSON files. A leading ~ expands to the remote extension host home directory.

agentStatus.markReadDelayMs.description: Delay before unread tasks are marked read while the VS Code window is focused.

agentStatus.staleAfterMinutes.description: Minutes without a hook update before a running session is shown as having unknown status.

agentStatus.renameActiveTerminal.description: Rename an agent's matching integrated terminal when it is selected or marked read.

agentStatus.showStatusBar.description: Show the selected agent session in the VS Code status bar.
